title: OpenSloper measurements file (.slm)
description: Made by opensloper-measurements: one person's measurements, with a value each, or a size table, with a value for each size. Patterns refer to a measurement by its key, as @waist.

format.description: What the file is; a file with another value does not load

version.description: The version of the format; a program refuses a file newer than it knows

units.description: Always mm: values in this file are millimetres

name.description: Whose measurements, or the name of the size table

notes.description: Notes, such as how they were taken

sizes.description: A size table's sizes, as named; left out for one person's set

measurements.description: The measurements, in the order shown

key.description: The name patterns use after @; letters, digits and underscore

value.description: The value, in a set with no sizes

values.description: In a size table, one value for each size in order; null for a size with no value
